guide.how.title: How support works
guide.how.body: Open a ticket with a category, a subject and your message. Support answers in the same ticket, and you get a notice when they reply. Close a ticket when you're done; a reply within 30 days of closing opens it again.
faq.secrets.q: What should I never put in a ticket?
faq.secrets.a: Passwords, one-time codes, keys and tokens. Support never asks for them.
faq.text.q: Why does my message look plain?
faq.text.a: Tickets are plain text. Formatting marks show as you typed them, so nothing in a message can run. Web addresses become links, and text that looks like a secret is hidden.
faq.limits.q: Why is there a limit on tickets?
faq.limits.a: Limits only stop floods. Paid accounts get more, and the New ticket form shows them when you get close.
